mapper.select: SELECT proj_id AS "id",proj_nm AS "name",proj_stat_cd AS "status",ctrt_type_cd AS "contractType",ctrt_bgn_dt AS "startDate",ctrt_end_dt AS "endDate" FROM tb_pj_proj WHERE proj_id=#{id}

SELECT dev_id AS "id",dev_nm AS "name",mng_no AS "managementNo",emp_type_cd AS "employeeType",drct_cls_cd AS "directClass",part_id AS "partId",use_yn AS "useYn",jncmp_dt AS "joinDate",retire_dt AS "retireDate" FROM tb_hr_dev WHERE dev_id=#{id}

SELECT p.proj_nm AS "projectName",d.dev_nm AS "developerName",d.mng_no AS "managementNo",COALESCE(c.code_nm,a.job_cd) AS "jobName" FROM tb_pj_asgn a JOIN tb_pj_proj p ON p.proj_id=a.proj_id JOIN tb_hr_dev d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code c ON c.code_grp_id='JOB' AND c.code=a.job_cd WHERE a.asgn_id=#{id}

SELECT json_build_object('assignment',(SELECT row_to_json(a) FROM tb_pj_asgn a WHERE asgn_id=#{id}), 'history',COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(h) ORDER BY hist_sn) FROM tb_pj_asgn_hist h WHERE asgn_id=#{id}),'[]'::json), 'months',COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(m) ORDER BY input_ym) FROM tb_pj_asgn_mon m WHERE asgn_id=#{id}),'[]'::json))::text

SELECT a.asgn_id FROM tb_pj_asgn a JOIN tb_hr_dev d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id WHERE ((a.input_bgn_dt < make_date(#{year}+1,1,1) AND a.input_end_dt >= make_date(#{year},1,1)) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_pj_asgn_mon m WHERE m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND left(m.input_ym,4)=CAST(#{year} AS text) AND (m.fix_yn='Y' OR m.input_ym < (SELECT std_val::bigint::text FROM tb_sy_oper_std WHERE std_cd='CASH_BASE_YM' ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_cl_close c WHERE c.close_ym=m.input_ym AND c.close_stat_cd='CLOSE')))) AND a.asgn_stat_cd!='CNCL' AND a.proj_id=#{projectId} AND a.job_cd=#{jobCode} AND (strpos(lower(d.dev_nm),lower(#{q})) > 0 OR strpos(lower(d.mng_no),lower(#{q})) > 0) ORDER BY a.asgn_id

SELECT DISTINCT ON(a.dev_id) a.dev_id AS "developerId",d.dev_nm AS "developerName",d.mng_no AS "managementNo",a.asgn_id AS "lastAssignmentId",a.input_end_dt AS "withdrawalDate" FROM tb_pj_asgn a JOIN tb_hr_dev d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id WHERE a.proj_id=#{projectId} AND a.dev_id!=#{developerId} AND a.asgn_stat_cd='ACT' ORDER BY a.dev_id,a.input_end_dt DESC,a.input_bgn_dt DESC,a.asgn_id DESC
SELECT asgn_id FROM tb_pj_asgn WHERE proj_id=#{projectId} AND dev_id=#{developerId} AND asgn_stat_cd='ACT' AND input_bgn_dt < #{date} AND input_end_dt >= #{date} ORDER BY asgn_id

SELECT json_build_object('project',(SELECT row_to_json(p) FROM tb_pj_proj p WHERE proj_id=#{projectId}), 'assignments',COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(a) ORDER BY asgn_id) FROM tb_pj_asgn a WHERE proj_id=#{projectId}),'[]'::json), 'history',COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(h) ORDER BY h.asgn_id,h.hist_sn) FROM tb_pj_asgn_hist h JOIN tb_pj_asgn a ON a.asgn_id=h.asgn_id WHERE a.proj_id=#{projectId}),'[]'::json), 'months',COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(m) ORDER BY m.asgn_id,m.input_ym) FROM tb_pj_asgn_mon m WHERE proj_id=#{projectId}),'[]'::json), 'close',COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(c) ORDER BY close_ym) FROM tb_cl_close c),'[]'::json), 'standards',COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(s) ORDER BY std_cd,aply_bgn_ym) FROM tb_sy_oper_std s WHERE std_cd IN ('CASH_BASE_YM','MM_OVER')),'[]'::json))::text
SELECT mon_uprc FROM tb_hr_dev_prc WHERE dev_id=#{developerId} AND aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} AND (aply_end_ym IS NULL OR aply_end_ym >= #{month}) ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT std_val FROM tb_sy_oper_std WHERE std_cd='MM_OVER' AND aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(sum(mon_mm),0) FROM tb_pj_asgn_mon WHERE dev_id=#{developerId} AND input_ym=#{month} AND asgn_id!=#{excludedId}
SELECT part_id FROM tb_pj_proj_part WHERE proj_id=#{projectId} AND aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_hr_dev_stat WHERE dev_id=#{developerId} AND work_stat_cd='LEAVE' AND bgn_dt <= #{endDate} AND (end_dt IS NULL OR end_dt >= #{startDate}))
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_sy_code WHERE code_grp_id=#{group} AND code=#{code} AND use_yn='Y' AND del_yn='N')

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_pj_asgn WHERE proj_id=#{projectId} AND dev_id=#{developerId} AND job_cd=#{jobCode} AND input_bgn_dt=#{startDate} AND input_end_dt=#{endDate} AND input_type_cd=#{inputType} AND asgn_stat_cd='ACT')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_pj_tk_dstrb WHERE proj_id=#{projectId} AND dev_id=#{developerId})
SELECT COALESCE(max(hist_sn),0)::int FROM tb_pj_asgn_hist WHERE asgn_id=#{id}
